events.title: GNU Project announced
events.summary: Richard Stallman launched a free-software movement that changed how code is shared and licensed.

narrative.whyChosen: It framed software freedom as a social issue, not just a technical preference.
narrative.whyImportant: GNU, copyleft, and free-software ethics directly influenced Linux, open source, and modern dev culture.
narrative.problemSolved: Proprietary UNIX-like systems were expensive and restrictive. Developers needed reusable, inspectable, shareable tools.

media.title: Linux distro culture meme
media.caption: Decades later, OS identity jokes are still part of hacker culture.
